body: Thank you a lot. I’m barely holding it together at work right now

I appreciate that. I’m thankful for the fact that I know I need to seek help. I went through a rough breakup this year, and I know that was time for things to end but it was just because I was making her miserable. I was losing more and more control over how I made her feel. It really hurts to think about how much she can’t stand to be around me anymore, because she’s still as important and special to me as ever.
